subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should OpenClaw enforce the documented Responses terminal-event contract for every `openai-responses` provider and use this PR as the canonical fix?
rationale: Failing terminal-less streams prevents silent message/session corruption, but intentionally makes nonconformant OpenAI-compatible proxies fail where they previously appeared successful; selecting between the overlapping PRs also requires owner intent.

options.title: Land this strict fix
options.body: Accept the documented terminal-event contract, refresh this branch against current main, land its proven state-machine implementation, and close the overlapping PR.

options.title: Prefer the alternate patch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 as the canonical direct-throw implementation after it gains comparable real HTTP behavior proof.

options.title: Preserve proxy compatibility
options.body: Keep permissive behavior by default and design an explicit strictness policy, accepting that silent terminal-less success remains until that product surface is defined.

recommendation.title: Land this strict fix
recommendation.body: Accept the documented terminal-event contract, refresh this branch against current main, land its proven state-machine implementation, and close the overlapping PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The transport adapter and Responses transport ownership trace most directly to this person's merged feature work.
